title: My plans with in sha Allah
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Eeman: angels, books and Qadr
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y1 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: my plans with in sha Allah)
intro: Lesson 18: Qadr: Allah knows everything; saying in sha Allah. To understand that everything happens by Allah's will, so we say in sha Allah when we plan to do something

questions.q: Finish the sentence: 'Tomorrow I will read my Qur'an, ...'
questions.model: Teacher says: 'Tomorrow I will help at home, in sha Allah.' Pupils clap once on 'in sha Allah'.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, write or say three plans for next week, each ending with إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.
questions.a: Three plans each ending with in sha Allah
questions.model: Teacher writes plan 1: 'I will tidy my room, in sha Allah (إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ).'

questions.q: when something sad happens, what helps us stay calm?
questions.a: Knowing Allah has a plan and being patient

questions.q: Back to our ponder: who knows what will happen tomorrow?
